enmarble.definition: v. t. To make hard as marble; to harden.
enmarble.translation: vt. 用大理石镶嵌 (或装饰)

enmesh.definition: v. entangle or catch in (or as if in) a mesh
enmesh.translation: vt. 使绊住, 使陷入

enmeshed.definition: s. caught as if in a mesh
enmeshed.translation: v. 使陷入（网中）( enmesh的过去式和过去分词 )

enmeshes.definition: v entangle or catch in (or as if in) a mesh
enmeshes.translation: v. 使陷入（网中）( enmesh的第三人称单数 )

enmeshing.definition: v entangle or catch in (or as if in) a mesh
enmeshing.translation: v. 使陷入（网中）( enmesh的现在分词 )

enmeshment.translation: n. 网捕, 包络；卷扫

enmities.translation: n. 仇恨( enmity的名词复数 ); 敌意; 敌视; 敌对的状态

enmity.definition:
n a state of deep-seated ill-will
n the feeling of a hostile person
